Vedanta Limited, a subsidiary of Vedanta Resources Limited (UK), is a globally diversified natural resources conglomerate. Headquartered in Mumbai, its operations span aluminum, copper, zinc, lead, silver, oil and gas, iron ore, and steel.

Aurobindo Pharma is a well-integrated global pharmaceutical firm committed to providing affordable and accessible medicines to patients around the globe. The company's vision is to become a leading and admired global pharmaceutical player, aiming to be ranked within the top 25 companies by the year 2030. Its mission focuses on being the most valued partner to the pharma industry by continuously developing and manufacturing products that meet the highest regulatory standards. The company develops and commercializes a diverse portfolio including generics, specialty products, injectables, active pharmaceutical ingredients, biosimilars, and vaccines across 150+ countries. Leveraging its expertise in large-scale production, the company has positioned itself as a cost-effective provider of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) for its own and external needs. As the 2nd largest listed Indian pharma company by revenue from operations, it has successfully established itself as a key player in the global market.

GE T&D India Ltd, GE Vernova's listed Electrification business in India, has been a leading player in power transmission and distribution for over 100 years. The company is committed to inventing and servicing technology to decarbonize the Indian grid, fostering access to secure, sustainable, reliable, and affordable electricity for all. It offers versatile solutions for connecting and moving power from generation sources, equipping utilities with the tools needed to support swift increases in energy demand. Its "Made in India" product range covers the entire power supply chain with equipment from medium to ultra-high voltage, including transformers, switchgears, and digital software. Operating from five manufacturing sites, the company is prepared to meet the growing need for grid equipment and services required by the industry. The company’s technology was vital in 2013, supporting the interconnection of India's five electrical regions into a single, unified national grid.

FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited (Nykaa) is a digitally native consumer technology platform, delivering a content-led, lifestyle retail experience to consumers for beauty, wellness, and fashion products.

United Spirits is India’s leading beverage alcohol company and a subsidiary of the global giant Diageo PLC. Headquartered in Bengaluru, it manufactures and sells a premium portfolio of over 80 brands, including McDowell’s No. 1, Royal Challenge, Signature, and Antiquity, alongside iconic Diageo brands like Johnnie Walker and Smirnoff.

With a sharpened focus on luxury brands like Johnnie Walker, USL is positioned to capitalize on India’s rapidly maturing consumer landscape.

Celebrating 35 years, Persistent Systems is a leading technology and services company built on a legacy of product engineering excellence and collaborative client relationships for businesses worldwide. Its core vision is 'Re(AI)magining the World,' investing in market-leading AI innovations to fundamentally transform client businesses across various industries and geographies. As a trusted partner, the company helps clients build new levels of adaptability and resiliency into their operations to address market challenges and create new avenues for growth. A key part of its strategy is partnering with hyperscalers and technology companies to engineer scalable agentic platforms using its unique Generative AI-enabled platform, SASVA. Persistent targets high-growth sub-verticals like BFSI and Healthcare with tailored AI solutions, such as intelligent insurance operations and personalized member experiences to deliver client value. In fiscal year 2025, the company reported $1.409 billion in revenue, an 18.8% year-on-year growth, while expanding its global team to over 24,500 employees.

As a world-class integrated player in the metals and mining industry, the company is revolutionizing iron ore mining, sponge iron manufacturing, and power generation in India. The company's vision is to be a value-added steel maker with integrated operations, aiming to become one of the industry's lowest-cost producers. Its mission is to provide top-quality products, maintain a safe work environment for its employees, and support the socio-economic development of its communities. The company pioneered iron ore mining in India and was the first to establish a DRI manufacturing unit in the Gadchiroli district. Strategically, its Surjagarh Iron Ore Mine is located in the center of India, making it equidistant from most major steel plants. With an allocated iron ore mine valid till 2057, the company is positioned to become one of India's prominent private steelmakers.

Ashok Leyland, a flagship of the Hinduja Group, is the second-largest manufacturer of commercial vehicles in India and the fourth-largest manufacturer of buses globally. Headquartered in Chennai, it operates nine manufacturing plants worldwide.

The company is aggressively scaling its green mobility footprint through its subsidiary, Switch Mobility.

MCX is India's largest commodity derivatives exchange, maintaining a dominant market share of over 95% in the commodity futures and options segment. Headquartered in Mumbai, it provides a platform for price discovery and risk management across bullion, energy, base metals, and agricultural commodities.

Since its inception in 2003, it has maintained a near-monopoly in non-agricultural commodity trading.

Founded by Dr. Desh Bandhu Gupta in 1968, Lupin's culture is driven by the vision of making quality healthcare accessible for all people. The company's central purpose, which it considers its 'North Star', is to catalyze treatments that transform hope into healing for patients everywhere. This purpose is anchored in three core commitments: providing relief from disease, innovating to unlock access at scale, and developing solutions for underserved communities. As a global pharmaceutical leader, Lupin has a strong presence across North America, EMEA, LATAM, APAC, and India, with its products distributed in over 100 markets. Its portfolio includes a wide range of generics, complex generics, specialty medicines, and biosimilars to expand access to quality healthcare for people globally. In its home market, the India business contributed 34% to total revenues in fiscal year 2025, ranking eighth in the Indian Pharmaceutical Market.

JSW Energy Limited is a leading independent power producer in India and a key part of the USD 23 billion JSW Group, a major Indian conglomerate. The company's vision is to become India’s leading power company, with a presence across power generation as well as energy products and services. Its primary mission is to provide the country with reliable, affordable, and sustainable power, supporting India's journey towards energy security and clean energy goals. Its operations are diversified across thermal, hydro, and renewable power sources, along with new-age businesses in energy storage, green hydrogen, and equipment manufacturing. The company strategically balances its portfolio with a mix of thermal and renewable assets to ensure a stable and reliable power supply for its customers. After surpassing its 10 GW capacity target, the company has set a new goal to achieve 30 GW of power generation by the year 2030.
Coforge Limited is a global digital services and solutions provider, offering IT consultancy, application development, and business process services.

Godrej Consumer Products, part of the 126-year-old Godrej Industries Group, is a leading emerging markets company committed to strong values like trust, integrity, and respect. The company's passion lies in delivering high-quality, affordable, and beautifully designed products with consumers at the core to meet their evolving needs. Its robust product lineup in Home and Personal Care enables it to deliver health and beauty benefits to consumers in emerging markets. The company's growth strategy is fundamentally driven by category development, which it considers its most distinctive lever for creating value. Its operations extend across India, Africa, Indonesia, Latin America, and the United States, with a strong focus on these key regions. In the fiscal year 2024-25, 38% of the company's total revenue was generated from its extensive international operations outside of India.

Ambuja Cements Limited, a key member of the diversified Adani Group, has been a leader in India's cement and building materials sector for over four decades. The company's vision is to become a world-class leader in businesses that enrich lives and contribute to building national infrastructure through sustainable value creation. Its primary mission is to be the world's largest, most innovative, and sustainable cement and building materials company, thereby creating value for people and employees. Operating with 24 integrated plants and 22 grinding units, the company consistently delivers superior quality products that facilitate seamless and eco-friendly construction projects across India. It is transforming industry standards by setting new benchmarks and establishing itself as one of the most cost-efficient cement manufacturers through its strategic approach. The company has achieved the remarkable milestone of crossing a consolidated cement capacity of 100 MTPA, making it the 9th largest cement business globally.

The story of Shree Cement is one of continuous progress, built on a foundation of trust, innovation, and shared aspirations. Its vision is to lead in creating prosperity and happiness for all stakeholders through pioneering innovation and embracing sustainable practices. The organization aims to be a top-tier, green building material solutions company in India, setting industry-leading performance benchmarks with strong brands and best-in-class people. Guided by the ancient teaching 'Let noble thoughts come to us from all over the World', the company imbibes these noble thoughts across all its functions. The company has also ventured into the Ready-Mix Concrete market, broadening its portfolio and reinforcing its commitment to high-quality construction solutions. Demonstrating environmental leadership, the company achieved a water positivity ratio exceeding 8 times in the fiscal year 2024-25, serving both operations and surrounding communities.
Max Healthcare Institute Limited is one of India's largest healthcare organizations, operating a network of tertiary and quaternary care hospitals in North India.

Bharat Forge Limited is a global leader that provides high-performance, safety-critical components and solutions to industries like automotive, aerospace, defence, and industrial equipment. Its strategic vision is to make India its center of gravity, focusing its capital and engineering attention where demand visibility and policy support are strongest. Over the decades, it has evolved from a single-location forging company into a diversified, multi-product enterprise driven by deep engineering know-how and cutting-edge manufacturing. The company's full-service capabilities range from design and engineering to testing and validation, enabling it to serve some of the world's most respected customers. Its strategy now focuses on scaling high-potential business verticals, strengthening its domestic foundations, and aligning its capital to build a core advantage. A key highlight is the contract signed with the Government of India to supply 184 ATAGS artillery platforms, valued at approximately ₹4,000 crore.

Oracle Financial Services Software Limited is a global leader, providing advanced financial technology solutions designed for the entire Financial Services Industry. The company's solutions aim to empower financial institutions, enabling them to become more responsive, agile, collaborative, and insightful in their business operations. It focuses on developing state-of-the-art solutions that improve customer experiences, enhance operational efficiency, and enable better risk management for financial institutions. The company's main business is its products segment, which offers a comprehensive suite of IT solutions delivering compelling digital experiences to financial institutions. Through significant investments in Research and Development, the company continuously drives innovation to maintain its leadership in the dynamic financial services space. As a result of its R&D efforts, the company has created IT products used by banks in over 150 countries for their critical operations.

Federal Bank operates as a key financial institution in India, with its business activities structured under two main divisions: Retail and Wholesale banking. The bank's vision is to become the 'Most Admired Bank' in the nation, distinguished by its digital capabilities and a dedicated focus on micro, medium, and middle market enterprises. It is guided by the principle of being 'Digital at the fore, human at the core', ensuring the highest standards of service for all its stakeholders. The bank is reaching every corner of India to meet its ever-growing number of customers through its branches and digital solutions. Its strategy involves devoting balanced attention to the interests and expectations of all stakeholders, particularly its customers, shareholders, and employees. With 141 new outlets added this fiscal year, the bank's network has grown to a robust 1,504 banking outlets across the nation.

Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd. (HPCL) is one of the largest public sector enterprises with 'Maharatna' status, operating under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India. The company's vision is to be a world-class energy provider known for delighting customers with high-quality products and innovative services across domestic and international markets, pursuing aggressive growth. Its mission involves becoming a fully integrated company in the hydrocarbons sector, focusing on enhancing productivity, quality, and profitability while caring for customers, employees, and the environment. HPCL supplies mobility fuels and LPG solutions to numerous Indian households and is the country's largest distributor of industrial and automotive lubricants, also transporting bulk petroleum products via pipelines. Furthermore, the company is progressively expanding its involvement in the renewable energy sector, particularly focusing on wind and solar power generation to diversify its energy portfolio. By enrolling over 28 lakh new customers during the year, the company has expanded its total LPG customer base to over 9.6 Crore, enhancing its nationwide reach.

ICICI Lombard General Insurance is recognized as the largest private sector General Insurance Company in India, catering to a wide array of customer needs. The company's primary vision is to establish itself as the most value-creating and admired provider of risk solutions in India, with an ambition for a global presence. It operates on the principle that insurance is a promise of protection and a commitment to support its customers during their most challenging times. Its business model serves individuals and small businesses through multiple channels, including agents, brokers, online platforms, and partnerships with banks. This customer-focused approach is driven by a core philosophy of 'One IL One Team,' which leverages the combined strengths of its teams to enhance customer experiences. Highlighting its digital success, the company's IL TakeCare App has been downloaded over 14.9 million times, offering features like health assessments and real-time vital tracking.

REC Limited is a Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the Ministry of Power. It functions as a premier Infrastructure Finance Company (IFC) that provides financial assistance to the entire power sector value chain, including generation, transmission, and distribution. 

In recent years, REC has pivoted strongly toward Green Energy financing, acting as the nodal agency for major government schemes like RDSS and PM-Surya Ghar (Muft Bijli Yojana).
Bharti Hexacom Limited provides telecommunication services in Rajasthan and North East circles, a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel.

IDBI Bank began as the Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI), the main institution for financing industrial and infrastructure growth in the country. Over six decades, it has transformed into a full-fledged commercial bank, playing a key role in shaping India's economic landscape by supporting people and businesses across the country. The bank's vision is to be the most preferred and trusted financial institution, continuously enhancing value for all its stakeholders, from customers to investors. At the core of its business strategy is a culture of strong risk management and careful compliance with all regulations. The bank focuses on growing its retail business by prioritizing low-cost deposits like Current and Savings Accounts (CASA) and expanding its loans to retail, agriculture, and MSME sectors. In the financial year 2024-25, the bank achieved its highest-ever net profit of ₹7,515 crore, reflecting strong and continuous improvement in profitability.

Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited is one of India's top defence shipyards, operating under the Ministry of Defence to build and repair naval assets. The company's vision is to be a progressive and profitable shipyard, building world-class warships and submarines using advanced, state-of-the-art technology. It aims to deliver quality ships on time and within budget, striving for global leadership in warship construction and ensuring high customer satisfaction. The company specializes in constructing, repairing, and refurbishing sophisticated warships and submarines at its facilities in Mumbai and Nhava for domestic and international clients. It is the only Indian shipyard that produces both destroyers and conventional submarines for the nation's navy, a key element of its unique capability. MDL has successfully achieved an indigenisation content of around 75% in its warships, which significantly reduces construction costs and dependency on imports.

Glenmark is a leading, research-led global pharmaceutical company with a diverse business that includes branded products, affordable generics, and over-the-counter (OTC) medicines. The company's vision is to emerge as a top global pharmaceutical player by leading with research and discovering new, impactful medicines for patients worldwide. A core principle guiding the company is its goal to democratize healthcare, making it available to more people through continuous innovation in its products and therapies. It specializes in creating medicines for key health areas such as Respiratory diseases, skin conditions (Dermatology), and cancer treatment (Oncology), addressing significant patient needs. Glenmark's strategy is centered on advancing its value chain, expanding its global footprint, and creating shareholder value through operational excellence and innovation. Currently, its branded medicines make up about 60% of total revenue, highlighting a strategic focus that the company aims to expand in the future.

Info Edge is a pioneering leader in India's online classifieds industry, managing a diverse portfolio of digital platforms in key life-stage sectors like recruitment, real estate, and matchmaking. Its guiding vision is to build and maintain world-class platforms that play a transformative and positive role in people’s lives at every significant personal and professional stage. The company's mission is to consistently delight customers by delivering superior value through innovative offerings on the internet and other digital platforms across its businesses. Its services address crucial life moments for millions, including finding a job, securing a home, seeking a life partner, or pursuing higher education opportunities. A key part of its strategy involves using a Freemium model for its matchmaking platform, Jeevansathi, to maximize user engagement and expand its market reach effectively. This focus on user growth has helped its primary recruitment platform, Naukri, build a massive database holding over 100 million registered resumes, solidifying market leadership.
JSW Infrastructure Limited is a leading private sector port operator in India, handling cargo for the JSW Group and third parties.

NHPC Limited, a Mini-ratna enterprise of the Government of India, stands as one of the country's leading developers in the hydro power sector for over four decades. Its guiding vision is to establish itself as a premier global organization dedicated to the sustainable development of clean power through responsible and innovative practices. A cornerstone of its mission is to adopt and innovate state-of-the-art technologies to optimize the use of natural resources through effective management. The company primarily develops clean energy by executing and operating projects efficiently, focusing on environmentally friendly and socio-economically responsive methods to create value. To further its growth, the company is in a rapid capacity addition mode, taking on new projects from diverse sources like hydropower and other renewables. A significant milestone showcasing its scale is the foundation laying for India's largest hydro power project, the 2880 MW Dibang Multipurpose Project.
The Phoenix Mills Limited is a leading real estate developer, owning and operating large malls and mixed-use developments.

Uno Minda Limited is a global technology leader in the auto component and systems manufacturing industry, supplying products to leading Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). Its vision is to become a sustainable global organization that increases value for all stakeholders, achieves technology leadership, and cares for its employees like family. The company's core strength lies in its customer-focused approach, which helps build long-standing relationships with leading vehicle manufacturers across the automotive industry. It produces a wide variety of parts including lighting, switches, seating, sensors, and components for electric vehicles, which are used in many types of vehicles. The company forms strategic partnerships with top global technology firms to introduce advanced innovations and manufacturing capabilities to the Indian market. To support its worldwide operations and serve its global clients, the company operates from 76 manufacturing plants located across the globe.

Dixon Technologies is one of India's leading providers of Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS), serving as the trustworthy 'Brand behind Brands' for globally acclaimed electronic companies. Its vision is to be the most preferred and trusted manufacturing partner for brands operating across all electronic verticals. A core mission is strengthening customer partnerships by providing products of the greatest value through innovation and excellence. The company designs and manufactures consumer electronics like LED TVs, home appliances such as washing machines, and various lighting solutions. It also operates a large Mobile & EMS division that manufactures mobile phones, hearables, wearables, and laptops for recognized global brands. This division is the largest growth driver, contributing over 60% of the company's consolidated total revenue.
AU Small Finance Bank Limited is a scheduled commercial bank providing a range of banking services, including savings accounts, loans, and insurance, with a focus on retail customers.

Havells is a premier Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) conglomerate with an extensive global presence. Headquartered in Noida, the company owns a prestigious brand portfolio including Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, Standard, and Reo.
Waaree Energies Limited is India's largest solar PV module manufacturer, also providing solar EPC services and independent power producer (IPP) solutions.
Ather Energy Limited is a leading electric vehicle manufacturer, designing and building smart electric scooters like the Ather 450X and operating a charging network.

SRF Limited is a chemical-based, multi-business conglomerate engaged in manufacturing industrial and specialty intermediates, with commercial interests in over one hundred countries. Its core aspiration is to achieve operational excellence through streamlined processes, digitalisation, and cost optimisation, ensuring superior quality, reliability, and service for its customers. The company is committed to building a professional reputation founded on strong ethics and integrity, striving to attract and nurture talent that delivers high-quality products. Its Specialty Chemicals business produces advanced active and non-active intermediaries used in the agrochemical and pharmaceutical industries, including custom research for major players. The Performance Films & Foil Business was established to reflect the company's business diversification and expansion beyond just packaging films into new product areas. Through its foundation, the company has made a significant social impact, touching the lives of 1,89,976 students across 493 Government schools in FY25.

Oil India Limited is the youngest Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise of India, operating as an integrated energy company committed to ensuring the nation's sustainable energy security. Its vision is to become a leading and future-ready integrated energy company, dedicated to the sustainable energy security of India through performance excellence. The company is driven by a commitment to provide reliable and affordable energy for the country's growing needs through a performance-oriented approach. The company's core activities involve exploration and production spread across various Indian states, including Assam, Rajasthan, and offshore areas like Andaman and Kerala-Konkan. Expanding its portfolio, the company has diversified into renewable energy, with a total installed capacity of 188.1 MW from wind and solar projects. During FY 2023-24, the company achieved its highest-ever natural gas production of 3,182 MMSCM, showcasing its strong operational performance.

SAIL is a Maharatna Central Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) and one of India's largest steel producers. It operates five integrated steel plants (Bhilai, Rourkela, Durgapur, Bokaro, and Burnpur) and three special steel plants.
NTPC Green Energy Limited, a subsidiary of NTPC, focuses on renewable energy projects, developing and operating solar and wind power assets to support India's green energy transition.

Celebrating a rich legacy, Bank of Maharashtra has proudly completed 90 glorious years of trust and service, establishing itself as an integral player in India's nation-building. The bank is dedicated to playing a pivotal role in fulfilling the aspirations of every Indian to achieve the national goal of a developed India (Viksit Bharat). It responsibly carries out its business with an intent to limit its carbon footprint while making banking services available to the last-mile person. To serve its customers, the bank operates a vast network spread across 28 states and 7 Union Territories with over 2600 branches nationwide. The bank is consistently improving its digital infrastructure and has introduced end-to-end digital processes for key loan schemes, like the PM SVANidhi loan. Financially, the bank achieved a significant 36.12% increase in net profit, which reached ₹5,520 crore for the year ending March 31, 2025.

Bank of India is a prominent public sector institution established as a Government of India undertaking, committed to serving the financial needs of the country. The bank's vision is to become a trusted partner in the progress of its stakeholders and the nation by offering responsible and relevant financial services. Its mission is to evolve into an institution delivering superior banking services by leveraging technology, founded on principles of safety, soundness, and customer-centricity. The bank is focused on building a sustainable banking portfolio with a strong digital presence, leveraging advanced technologies and working closely with various stakeholders. The bank's global business mix grew by 12.02% year-on-year, with an incremental increase of ₹1.59 Lakh Crore to reach ₹14.83 Lakh Crore. It achieved a net profit of ₹9,219 Crore in FY25, marking a remarkable 45.92% year-on-year growth and demonstrating strong financial performance.

IndusInd Bank is a leading Indian financial institution that has integrated Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles into its business operations, risk underwriting, and reporting practices. The bank envisions being a forerunner in the marketplace, delivering sustainable growth by excelling in productivity, technology, and efficiency to enhance returns for all stakeholders. Its mission is to consistently add value by enhancing organizational sustainability, aiming to emerge as India's most convenient bank with top-tier financial metrics. For three decades, the bank has offered a comprehensive range of products and services, including microfinance, personal and commercial vehicle loans, and SME loans. Through pioneering digital solutions like the INDIE app, it is making banking more intuitive and innovative, remaining steadfast in its commitment to being a reliable partner. As India's 5th largest private bank, it is the preferred banking provider for 39 million customers, including individuals, corporations, and government entities.
Bajaj Housing Finance Limited is a non-deposit taking Housing Finance Company offering home loans, loans against property, and developer finance, catering to retail and corporate customers.

IDFC FIRST Bank is focused on building a comprehensive suite of universal banking products and solutions, preparing for opportunities across all major economic segments in India. The bank is singularly focused on its vision 'To build a world-class bank in India', ensuring every action taken is aligned with this long-term goal. A core operational principle is 'Ethical Banking', which ensures its products are so customer-friendly that employees can confidently recommend them to their own loved ones. The bank operates three primary lines of businesses – Lending, Deposits, and Credit Cards, which are steadily moving towards greater profitability as they mature. Embracing a 'Digital First' approach, the bank now conducts 98.7% of all its transactions digitally through internet, mobile, prepaid, and FASTag services. Since its merger in December 2018, the bank has expanded its branch network by five times, growing from 206 to 1,002 branches by March 2025.

Prestige Group has a business model built on strategic diversification, establishing a solid footprint in various segments like residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, and property management. The company's commercial strategy is rooted in a forward-looking approach that prioritises sustainability, innovation, and a focus on client needs. A key part of its business includes providing world-class support and maintenance for all its properties to uphold high standards. Its residential offerings are diverse, including integrated townships, apartments, luxury villas, plotted developments, and even golf course-oriented projects for various customers. In the commercial space, the company's expertise lies in building modern office environments in key locations across major cities in India. Demonstrating its extensive experience, the company has successfully delivered 300 projects covering an impressive 190 million square feet of space.
Nippon Life India Asset Management Limited is one of India's leading asset management companies, managing mutual funds and portfolio management services.

Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited is recognized as one of India's most respected financial services companies, built on a strong combination of promoter vision and professional expertise. The company's core purpose is to become a well-respected and preferred global financial services organization that enables wealth creation for all its customers. Its asset management business is driven by the core investment philosophy of QGLP, which stands for Quality, Growth, Longevity, and Price. The firm's Wealth Management services assist mass-affluent and high net worth individuals in managing their money through strong, research-based advice. Through its Capital Market business, the company offers investment banking and institutional equity services, supported by highly-rated research and efficient trading. The company manages and advises on assets worth ₹5.5 trillion, covering over 300 companies with its equity research.

For over five decades, Alkem Laboratories has been a leading force in India's pharmaceutical landscape, dedicated to ensuring quality, accessibility, and trust in healthcare. The company's core mission is to extend lifecare beyond all boundaries, viewing each treatment as a means to safeguard futures and nurture families. It operates with a dual commitment to strengthening its present operations while also building for the future, which guides every strategic decision made. The company operates across the pharmaceutical value chain, focusing on branded generics, complex generics, biosimilars, and nutraceuticals to meet global healthcare needs. While maintaining its leadership in acute therapies, the company is also experiencing promising growth in chronic segments like anti-diabetics and neurology. Alkem proudly ranks among the top five pharmaceutical companies in India, with its leading brands like Clavam and Pan-D featuring among the nation's top 50.

Oberoi Realty Limited is a premier Indian company primarily focused on real estate development and hospitality, with a strong presence across the Mumbai region. Its core vision is to transform promising locations into comprehensive integrated lifestyle destinations, creating spaces that enhance the quality of urban living for residents and customers. The company is dedicated to sustainable development, demonstrated by its strict adherence to green building standards and the use of eco-friendly construction materials in its projects. The firm develops a diverse portfolio including iconic residential towers, Grade-A office assets, retail malls, hotels, and social infrastructure like international schools. It operates an outsourcing model, appointing globally renowned architects and contractors, which allows for scalability and a focus on contemporary design and quality construction. Over its four decades of experience, the group has developed 50 projects at strategic locations across Mumbai, totaling approximately 15.9 million square feet.

Aster DM Healthcare began its journey as a single clinic in Dubai in 1987 and has since become a leading integrated private healthcare provider with operations across India. The company's overarching purpose is a caring mission with a global vision to serve the world with accessible and affordable quality healthcare for everyone. This is centered on its guiding promise, 'We'll Treat You Well,' which encapsulates the organization's purpose and philosophy in its interactions with all stakeholders. Its extensive network in India includes 19 hospitals, 13 clinics, 232 labs, and patient experience centres across five states, featuring a total bed capacity of 4,867. The business model is strategically de-risked, with 58% of its revenue generated from specialized services like Cardiac Sciences, Neurology, Oncology, and Orthopaedics, ensuring financial stability. Reflecting its strong growth, the company is one of India's fastest-growing hospital chains, with revenue growing at a 23% CAGR over the last five years.
Kalyan Jewellers India Limited is one of the largest jewelry retailers in India and the Middle East, designing and selling gold, diamond, and precious metal jewelry.

ICICI Prudential Life Insurance is a leading private sector insurer in India, jointly promoted by ICICI Bank Limited and Prudential Corporation Holdings Limited of the UK. Its vision is to build a lasting institution that sensitively serves the protection and long-term savings needs of its customers. Guided by core values such as 'Customer First' and 'Integrity,' the company ensures that customer needs are central to its operations. It offers a comprehensive suite of products for life protection, healthcare, retirement planning, and long-term savings, distributed through a diverse network. The company uses data analytics and digitalization to innovate and deliver a hassle-free experience to customers and distributors, from purchase to claim settlement. As a testament to its scale and customer trust, the company's Assets Under Management (AUM) stood at ₹3.1 trillion as of March 31, 2025.
Dabur India Limited is one of India's leading FMCG companies, dealing in personal care, healthcare, and food products with a focus on Ayurveda.

Adani Total Gas Limited is India’s leading private City Gas Distribution (CGD) company, supplying Piped Natural Gas (PNG) to domestic, commercial, and industrial sectors and Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) to the transport sector.

L&T Finance is one of India's leading Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFC), headquartered in Mumbai, and is part of the illustrious L&T Group. Its core vision is to be an admired and inspirational financial institution that consistently creates sustainable value for all its stakeholders. The company actively promotes financial inclusion by extending products to society's financially excluded sections, helping democratise credit access for underserved communities. The company has successfully transformed into a retail-focused lender, a key achievement under its ‘Lakshya 2026’ goals which were met well ahead of schedule. Its business is powered by technology, with a 100% paperless journey for many of its retail and SME finance products to enhance efficiency. This digital-first approach has helped the company build a superior retail franchise with a retail book exceeding ₹80,000 crore and serving over 2.3 crore customers.
